ListQueryHttpCode.summary: Querying HTTP Status Codes for Pulling Live Streams

ListRecordData.description: Queries the maximum number of recording channels per hour. The total number of recording channels in every minute of an hour is collected, and the maximum value is used as the statistical value. The maximum query time span is 31 days. You can query data over the past one year.

ListRecordRules.name: ListRecordRules
ListRecordRules.description: This API is used to query recording templates that meet specific conditions.

ListSingleStreamBitrate.name: ListSingleStreamBitrate
ListSingleStreamBitrate.description: Queries the stream bitrate. The maximum query time span is one day. You can query data over the past month. The granularity of the returned bitrate data is 1 second.

ListSingleStreamDetail.name: ListSingleStreamDetail
ListSingleStreamDetail.description: Queries stream monitoring data, including the frame rate, bitrate, and stream interruption. The maximum query time span is one day. You can query data over the past month. The granularity of the returned bitrate data is 1 second.

ListSingleStreamFramerate.name: ListSingleStreamFramerate
ListSingleStreamFramerate.description: Queries the stream frame rate. The maximum query time span is one day. You can query data over the past month. The granularity of the returned frame rate data is 1 second.

ListTranscodeConcurrencyNum.summary: Querying Transcoded Streams of Ingest Domain Names
ListTranscodeConcurrencyNum.description: Queries the number of transcoded streams of ingest domain names. After a time point and granularity are specified, the number of transcoded streams is returned. The maximum query time span is one day. You can query data from the past 90 days, and the data delay is 5 minutes.

ListTranscodeData.name: ListTranscodeData
ListTranscodeData.summary: Querying the Duration of Transcoded Outputs
ListTranscodeData.description: Queries the transcoding duration per hour. The maximum query time span is 31 days. You can query data over the past one year. Data about the transcoded output duration is delayed for one hour.

ListTranscodeTaskDetail.description: Queries stream transcoding information, including the stream name, template, format, and duration. The maximum query time span is one day. You can query data from the past 14 days.

ListUpStreamDetail.description: Queries CDN upstream streaming quality data The maximum query time span is one day. You can query data over the past seven days. The returned CDN upstream streaming quality data is accurate to one minute.

ListUsersOfStream.name: ListUsersOfStream
ListUsersOfStream.description: Queries the number of viewers. The maximum query time span is 31 days. You can query data over the past one year.
